summary: @or-sdk/settings preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle unrelated to advertised purpose
details: The package advertises itself as a settings SDK but its `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. The invoked file `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) obfuscated with an obfuscator.io-style shuffled string-array decoder (`WV8StW`, `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`, hex-named identifiers, mixed hex/string arrays). The filename and content are unrelated to a settings SDK, and the payload is deliberately executed by a freshly-downloaded alien runtime rather than by Node, evading Node-scoped scanners and analysis tooling. Running `npm install @or-sdk/settings` executes this opaque payload on the installer's machine with the installer's user privileges — an install-time remote code execution surface, with the shipped bytes being attacker-controlled and unauditable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
